svg.text: F7: Angular Velocity Poisson Kinematics vs Euler Differences
svg.title: F7: Angular Velocity Poisson Kinematics vs Euler Differences
svg.desc: synthetic: Comparison of true angular velocity from Poisson rotation differences against naive Euler angle time differentiation under noise and near gimbal lock. Labelled synthetic.
svg.text: Euler angle rates are not angular velocity: R_dot = [omega]_x R.
